title: When typing characters in the input box, the pre-editing panel of the Chinese input method moves up and down, left and right, making it difficult to use.
body:

### Electron Version

electron v44.0.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Ubuntu

### Operating System Version

Ubuntu26.04 LTS (Wayland)

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

electron v44.0.0

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

Yes

### Expected Behavior

Input source pre-editing panel no longer randomly jumps up, down, left, and right

### Actual Behavior

When you type characters in the input box, the pre-editing panel of Chinese input sources moves up and down, left and right, making it difficult to use.
